stops.title: Ɛvri Branch
stops.caption: Di ol nɛtwɔk, lis.
stops.speech: Branch de lis ɛvri ples we di chɔch de ron, di siti, di rijɔn ɛn omɔch pipul de na di kɔngrigeshɔn.

stops.title: Insay Wan
stops.caption: Sɛtin, lidaship ɛn mɛmba dɛn.
stops.speech: Opin wan branch fɔ sɛt in infɔmeshɔn, gi in pasto ɛn admin dɛn, ɛn si di mɛmba, grup ɛn sɛvis dɛn we bilɔng to am.
